items.title: Create executable spec references/loop-agent-selection.py (shared types + resolve/render_launch/classify/needs_precheck/advertised_set)
items.description:
Work in the feature-forge repo at /home/gary/workspace/feature-forge (CON-01); specs live in the rauf repo at specs/agent-agnostic/forge-rauf-loop-default/. Create the NEW file references/loop-agent-selection.py -- the single importable module that captures the documented selection algorithm so the test cannot drift from the skill prose. Python 3.10+ (X | Y unions, match), stdlib only, full type annotations + Google-style docstrings (Python stack profile). It is a TEST-ONLY + doc artifact (OQ-T1 RESOLVED): the skills stay prose; this module is NOT wired into any generated adapter, so it neither triggers nor is checked by the build-adapters drift guard -- do NOT regenerate adapters for this item.

1. Shared types -- reproduce VERBATIM from spec 00 section 4: AgentAvailability (the _AgentRow TypedDict required base {id, displayName, available} + the total=False subclass adding binaryName/detail -- 3.10-compatible, no NotRequired); AgentSource(str, Enum) = RUN/PROJECT/DEFAULT ("run"/"project"/"default"); Resolution frozen dataclass {agent: str | None, source: AgentSource}; Verdict(str, Enum) = AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN; Classification frozen dataclass {verdict, detail=None, valid_ids=None}; AdvertisedSet = frozenset[str].
2. Constants -- from spec 00 section 2: RUNNER_DEFAULT_ID: str = "claude-cli"; MIN_RUNNER_VERSION: str = "0.6.0".
3. Functions (copy the bodies VERBATIM from the specs; they are pure + total):
   - resolve(run_selection, default_agent, runner_default_id) -> Resolution -- spec 03 section 3.1 (run>project, empty/whitespace-as-unset via the _clean helper, an explicit runner_default_id pick collapses to Resolution(agent=None, source=DEFAULT)).
   - render_launch(base_cmd, agent_argument, resolved, runner_default_id) -> str -- spec 03 section 3.4 (returns base_cmd unchanged for agent_argument falsy / resolved.agent None / resolved.agent == runner_default_id; else appends ' ' + agent_argument with {agent} replaced).
   - classify(resolved_agent, agents, runner_default_id) -> Classification -- spec 04 section 3.2 (match on advertised.get(resolved_agent): None -> UNKNOWN with valid_ids=tuple(sorted(advertised)); {"available": True} -> AVAILABLE; else -> UNAVAILABLE with detail=row.get("detail")).
   - needs_precheck(resolution_agent, runner_default_id) -> bool -- spec 04 section 1 (True iff non-None and != runner_default_id).
   - advertised_set(agents) -> AdvertisedSet -- spec 04 section 2 (frozenset of str(row["id"])).

HARD CONSTRAINTS: the module must be importable as `loop_agent_selection`; NO third-party imports; NO function reads a backlog item or accepts an item_provider/backlog argument (REQ-AGENT-05 invariant). Probe-failure handling (empty/missing-id/bad-JSON) is NOT in classify -- it is handled by the caller before classify per spec 04 section 5 (classify Raises: Never).
acceptanceCriteria: references/loop-agent-selection.py exists, is Python 3.10+ stdlib-only, and imports cleanly as the module loop_agent_selection (no third-party imports)

Defines AgentAvailability, AgentSource (RUN/PROJECT/DEFAULT), Resolution (frozen), Verdict (AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN), Classification (frozen), AdvertisedSet, and the constants RUNNER_DEFAULT_ID == "claude-cli" and MIN_RUNNER_VERSION == "0.6.0", matching spec 00 sections 2 and 4

resolve(...) implements run > project precedence with empty/whitespace treated as unset and collapses an explicit runner_default_id pick to Resolution(agent=None, source=AgentSource.DEFAULT) (spec 03 sections 3.1-3.2): e.g. resolve("codex","gemini","claude-cli")==Resolution("codex",RUN); resolve(None,"gemini","claude-cli")==Resolution("gemini",PROJECT); resolve(None,"","claude-cli")==Resolution(None,DEFAULT); resolve("claude-cli","gemini","claude-cli")==Resolution(None,DEFAULT)

render_launch(...) returns base_cmd unchanged when agent_argument is falsy, resolved.agent is None, or resolved.agent == runner_default_id; otherwise appends ' ' + agent_argument with {agent} substituted by resolved.agent (spec 03 section 3.4)

classify(...) returns Verdict.UNKNOWN with valid_ids == tuple(sorted advertised ids) for a non-member, Verdict.UNAVAILABLE with detail from the row for a member with available False, and Verdict.AVAILABLE for a member with available True; it is total and never raises (spec 04 section 3.2)
needs_precheck(...) returns True only for a non-None, non-default id (spec 04 section 1); advertised_set(...) returns a frozenset of every row id (spec 04 section 2)
No function in the module reads a BacklogItem or accepts an item-provider/backlog argument (REQ-AGENT-05)
The module is NOT referenced by any file under adapters/; python3 scripts/build-adapters.py --check passes with no regeneration required for this file (OQ-T1 test-only)
bash scripts/validate.sh passes end-to-end from the feature-forge repo root
items.notes: This single module embodies spec 00's types/constants, spec 03's resolve/render_launch, and spec 04's classify/needs_precheck/advertised_set -- copy the function bodies and docstrings verbatim from those specs so the executable spec cannot diverge from the prose. items.description:

   - `agents --json` -> print a canned { "agents": [...] } and exit 0 (ALWAYS exit 0). The exact mix from spec 07 sections 3.2/4: claude-cli available, codex available:true, gemini available:false WITH a detail, and NO row for `bogus`.

2. tests/test_loop_agent_selection.py (pytest) importing resolve/render_launch/classify/needs_precheck/advertised_set + the types from references/loop-agent-selection.py. Cover every case in spec 07 sections 3.1-3.6:

   - 3.2 Probe split: classify codex->AVAILABLE, gemini->UNAVAILABLE (detail populated), bogus->UNKNOWN with valid_ids == tuple(sorted({"claude-cli","codex","gemini"})) and NO proceed-anyway offered (SC-08); plus the once-no-retries assertion -- the recorded argv shows exactly one `agents --json` per non-default launch attempt (REQ-PERF-02).
   - 3.3 Command render: render_launch(base,"--agent {agent}",Resolution("codex",RUN),"claude-cli") -> base + " --agent codex"; Resolution(None,DEFAULT) and Resolution("claude-cli",RUN) both -> base unchanged; an UNKNOWN id never reaches render_launch (allow-list, REQ-SEC-01).
